project_relation.project_measurement_contract: position and two chamber pressures measurable; velocity estimated
project_relation.l09_requirement: full state including x2 directly in the control and adaptation laws; no observer or differentiator
project_relation.coverage: L09 does not cover the case where x2 is replaced by an estimate; the theorem would need a new proof
project_relation.model_note: L09 is a third-order model with a static valve; the current four-state simulation in this project is not a verified third-order model
project_relation.time_note: L09 has no time guarantee; nonzero disturbance and bounded input do not by themselves exclude finite time, but this paper provides no such structure; a positive constant remainder cannot yield exact zeroing, which does not deny other robust structures
